title: Temple City Special City Council September 15, 2026

segments.text: I like to call to order the
special meeting for the City Council of
Temple City to order for September 15th,
Uh can we get a roll call, please?
>> Yes, Mayor.
Council member Chavez?
>> Here.
>> Council member Sternquist?
>> Here.
>> Council member Yu?
Absent.
Mayor Pro Tem Chen?
>> Here.
>> Mayor Man?
>> Here.
Do we have a motion to excuse Council
member Yu?
All right. I'll second that. He is move
He is uh excused. Uh we move to close
session. There are two items in our
close session, which I would ask our
city attorney to describe.
>> Thank you, Mr. Mayor. One item is a
potential initiation of litigation under
Section 54956.9D
four of the Brown Act. The other is
discussion of existing litigation under
uh regarding the matter Church of the
Nazarene versus City with the Superior
Court case caption uh
in full on the agenda. Thank you very
much.
>> Okay, sounds good. So, at this time
Council will
uh
move into close session, and we will
report out afterwards.
All right, good evening, everyone. So,
City Council has returned from close
session. So, at this time I'd like to
ask our city attorney to report out of
close session.
>> Thank you, Mr. Mayor. Uh
the City Council spoke or the City
Council was briefed and gave direction
on two items. Uh item A, potential
initiation of litigation, a briefing was
held, discussion was held. The uh
discussion did not result in any uh
action reportable under the Brown Act.
Item B, the existing litigation matter,
uh
again Council was briefed, a discussion
was held. The Council gave direction to
city staff and the city attorney's
office to settle the matter on certain
defined terms. If those terms are met,
then a settlement can be signed off by
the city manager and by the city
attorney's office, be approved by the
court, and then the settlement agreement
would be available at the city clerk's
office. If the terms are not met, then
the matter would come back for future
city council consideration.
>> Thank you very much, sir. Okay, thank
you. So, at this point, I will adjourn
our closed session. We're going to take
a quick several minute break so that we
can reset our media. Thank you all for
your patience, and we will start the
regular meeting very shortly. So, we are
adjourned for closed session.
